page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.xlarge is a compute-optimized, Arm-based instance powered by dedicated AWS Graviton processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. Built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor, the instance provides 4 physical arm64 cores and 4 vCPUs without hyperthreading, resulting in 1 thread per core. System memory is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio suited for compute-focused tasks.

The instance includes bundled local storage consisting of a 237 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Baseline network throughput is rated at 2 Gbps. The combination of dedicated arm64 execution units, low-latency NVMe local storage, and high compute density per gigabyte of RAM makes the c9gd.xlarge effective for sustained compute workloads, temporary file processing, build systems, web serving, and distributed caching nodes.
description: Amazon Web Services c9gd.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance driven by 4 dedicated AWS Graviton arm64 cores running at 3.3 GHz. Managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it features 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance comes equipped with 237 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD instance store and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Lacking hardware GPUs, it relies entirely on its custom Arm architecture to deliver predictable per-core execution. The integration of high clock speeds, dedicated core allocation, and local high-speed SSD storage offers resource density for compute-intensive applications requiring fast local temporary storage, such as CI/CD build environments, batch data processing, web serving, and log analysis.
